Introduction

Dongsung is the bassist and vocalist of N.Flying. He was previously the bassist and vocalist of HONEYST.

Before debuting, he competed in the survival show d.o.b. (Dance or Band) by FNC Entertainment and Mnet as part of the NEOZ Band team. Although his team lost to the NEOZ Dance team, he eventually debuted in May 2017 with the band HONEYST, alongside the other NEOZ Band members.

HONEYST disbanded in April 2019, and in December 2019 it was announced that Dongsung would be joining N.Flying as their new bassist. He was officially added as a member in January 2020 and made his debut with the band in June 2020 through N.Flying's 7th mini album So, COMMUNICATION.
